title: Deferred amounts as compensation.
bodyText: Any compensation deferred pursuant to a plan established under this chapter shall be deemed regular compensation, but shall not be included in the computation of federal income taxes withheld on behalf of any participating employee.
bodyHtml: [§88F-10]  Deferred amounts as compensation.  Any compensation deferred pursuant to a plan established under this chapter shall be deemed regular compensation, but shall not be included in the computation of federal income taxes withheld on behalf of any participating employee. [L 1996, c 212, pt of §2]
